name: figma-local-bridge
description: Inspect and edit the Figma Design file open in Figma Desktop through a local MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and safely edit an open Figma file.
interface.longDescription: A local-only MCP bridge and inspect-first workflow for design-system-aware reading, editing, auditing, composing, and exporting of the Figma Design file currently open in Figma Desktop.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect the open Figma file and list its artboards.
